We report that, in addition to theta oscillations, hippocampal SPW-Rs are important. Enhanced cholinergic activation in the hippocampus during the delay between choices in a spontaneous alternation task abolished SPW-Rs and impaired choice performance in mice. Our findings also demonstrate that the outcome of optogenetic manipulation of a key neurotransmitter, acetylcholine (ACh), depends on the state of the brain at the time of the
